host_processor_caches: L3 256 MB + L2 64 MB per socket (EPYC 9575F)
host_storage_capacity: 8x 3.84 TB NVMe (30.72 TB ephemeral); shared dataset on Crusoe fs (VAST NFS, RWX)

host_networking_topology: RoCE Ethernet, 8-rail rail-optimized (no InfiniBand); inter-node gradient/collective traffic

accelerator_interconnect_topology: single-node 8-GPU XGMI mesh; inter-node via 8x400G RoCE (3200 Gbps)
hw_notes: Crusoe Cloud SKU mi355x-288gb-roce.8x (zone us-east2-a): 240 vCPU AMD EPYC (Turin), 3000 GB RAM, 8x AMD MI355X 288GB OAM, 8x 3.84 TB NVMe ephemeral, RoCE RDMA 3200 Gbps (8x400G), 175 Gbps VPC, 25 Gbps block storage. 4 node(s) = 32 GPU. VM-virtualized.
framework: flux1: PyTorch (ROCm 7.0.2) + TransformerEngine (fp8), MLPerf flux1 reference harness (torchtitan/NeMo); llama: AMD Primus (Megatron-LM pretrain), from rocm/amd-mlperf:llama31_8b_training_6.0 (PyTorch 2.10 ROCm, TransformerEngine ROCm, AITER)
other_software_stack: flux1: ROCm 7.0.2, RCCL 7.0.2, AMD ANP v1.2.0, libionic 1.117.5-a-77 (ainic RoCE), AITER, hipBLASLt; llama: ROCm 7.2.0, RCCL 2.27.7, hipBLASLt 1.2.0, AITER 77455e3 (+ asm_gemm_a4w4 macro fix), TransformerEngine ROCm 261eda6, Primus d53c428, libionic 1.117.5-a-77 (AMD Pollara AINIC RoCE), Kubernetes (Crusoe Managed Kubernetes)
sw_notes: MLPerf Training v6.1 closed. flux1: fp8 (delayed/hybrid e4m3) GEMMs + fp8 DPA, bf16-mixed base, bf16 gradient all-reduce, data parallel with no gradient accumulation (MBS = GBS / GPUs). llama31_8b: MXFP4 GEMMs (FP8 hybrid warmup), data parallel.
